title: Wyrms of Nyrus Emissive
description: Makes certain block/item textures glow in the dark. Requires Optifine to function.
body:
Makes specific blocks and items from Wyrms of Nyrus glow in the dark utilizing Optifine's Emissive shading system. Should work with any and all shaders.

See gallery for examples of glowing items/blocks.

 

Credit to Modrome, the author of Wyrms of Nyrus for all textures, and for permission to create the resource pack.
